title: A recurrent two-linkage binary model defeats naive single-last-mark gluing
statement: For the native binary two-linkage network0<->A with rates k_plus,k_minus and A+B<->A+C with rates u,v>0, class A=n>=0,B+C=1, the exact invariant probability is Poisson(k_plus/k_minus) times B/C weights(v,u)/(u+v), with detailed balance on every edge. Native immigration-death A is nonexplosive and finite-interval switch intensity is integrable. Nevertheless, at reachable last-target state((n,1,0),A+B),n>1, the carried-target factorial V=sum_i log((x_i-t_i)!) has birth/death/switch increments log n,0,0 when each fired reaction updates the last mark to its target. Its embedded one-step mean is k_plus log n/[k_plus+(k_minus+u)n]>0; the C-mark analogue uses v. Every designated within-link target-following episode has positive expected drift, so the single-last-mark finite-exceptional-set construction cannot be glued naively over linkage classes on infinitely many marked states, despite positive recurrence. Ordinary unmarked log(n!) has CTMC drift k_plus log(n+1)-k_minus*n*log n<0 eventually.

evidence.quote: single-last-mark finite-exceptional-set argument does NOT glue directly across linkage classes
evidence.range_scope: Actual root analytic all-n calculation in the existing recurrence context. Eight exact fixtures are only reported finite corroboration; no new Capital reproof or general theorem.

requires: Exact native falling-factorial propensities at fixed positive rates, communicating class A=n>=0,B+C=1, carried target is the last fired reaction target. Kriebelv1.2.4 single-last-mark construction is the proposed transferred representation, not an asserted theorem for every linkage class.

assumptions: A scoped failure of one transferred marked-state representation, not a recurrence/nonexplosion counterexample, unrestricted impossibility, general strong-endotactic negative or broad impact/priority claim. The accepted N1567 terminal-gap sufficient conditions and historical reviews, and N1648 explicitly conditional envelopes, remain at their original scopes; this calculation does not refute those conditions/theorems. Finite fixtures alone do not establish the analytic all-n statement.
costs: Analytic all-n stationary law and drift supplied by root. Eight exact rational factorial/detailed-balance fixtures were reported only; none executed by Capital. Native CTMC physical drift and embedded-jump mean are distinct; no general compiler/mixing or acquisition bound is added.
